args.code: var old=UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes; var path="Assets/Scenes/Stage3.unity"; var list=old.Where(s=>s.path!=path).ToList(); UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes=list.ToArray(); var entry=new UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettingsScene(path,true); entry.guid=new UnityEditor.GUID(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(path)); var intended=entry.guid.ToString(); list.Add(entry); UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes=list.ToArray(); return new{intended=intended,actual=UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Last().guid.ToString()};
